verses.verse:
योगेश्वरस्य कृष्णस्य यथा गीता जनप्रिया।
संगीते श्रद्दधानानाम् कृष्णावंशी तथा प्रिया।।३।।
verses.text: Just as the Gītā of Kṛṣṇa, lord of yoga, is dear to people, so the Kṛṣṇā bānsurī is dear to those who have faith in music.

commentary.text: Just as the Gītā of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa is dear to people, in the same way the āḍī bansī (transverse, side-blown bānsurī) is very dear to lovers of music. If he recited the Gītā to free Arjuna from delusion, he played the bānsurī to free the gopīs from attachment.
